source: No data dictionary, schema, or structured export documentation provided
note: The vendor provides zero structured documentation of the EHI export contents. The entire (b)(10) documentation is a 36-word footnote stating that data can be exported as PDF or C-CDA. No entities, tables, fields, schemas, or sample data are documented anywhere in the public-facing artifacts.

export_formats.description: Non-computable rendering of patient chart. No specification of what data elements are included.
Clinical Document Architecture document. Likely the same C-CDA used for Transitions of Care (b)(1). Covers USCDI-aligned clinical summary data only.
